metadata.comment: sizeMode contentHeight, not the default contentSize: in contentSize the width port is inert and the field keeps the browser's intrinsic width at every screen size.

parameters.text: You already have a habit with that name.

metadata.comment: mounted, not visible: visible keeps the space it occupies, which would leave a hole under the field whenever there is nothing to say.

parameters.text: Add the first thing you want to do every day — ticking it off takes one tap.

metadata.comment: The only node that reads or writes habit-tracker.habits.v1. One input, because a press can carry a string and nothing else — and one Function, because a habit's ticks are always read and written with the habit.
The field's live text is the pending value; the Add button and Enter both commit it, so typing never adds anything by itself.
One line, so no code node: it decides whether Add may be pressed at all — a name is needed, and a name already in the list is refused.

The channel a habit row publishes its command on. A row cannot hand the page a value through the Repeater — the Repeater fills an item output only as part of its own action flow — so the row writes this one app-wide variable and the store reads it, which is the documented shape for a value crossing between two components.
